findings.reason: §7's flag-flip is exactly what makes plan reviews collide once session_reuse is on, so without a declared gate §7 can land before §11 and re-create the cross-plan-review session reuse §11 exists to remove.
findings.text: §11 introduces an ordering precondition on §7 ("§7 must not flip the flag before this section lands") that no relationship declares: §11's `data-links` is empty, the plan carries no `plan-section-depends-on` mapping, and §7's own text (plan.html:425-429) flips `session_reuse` back to true "After §2 and §3 land" with no mention of §11 — so a coordinator routing the roadmap can dispatch §7 first.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every `file:line` anchor resolves at main `fb4b21fb`: `recovery_review_delivery.py:44`, `recovery.py:199`, `recovery_watch.py:512`, `dispatch_sessions.py:456` and `:495`, `dispatch.py:2881` (the `_is_review_run` re-export line); the `dispatch_sessions.py:604` citation resolves inside the named `_prior_same_task_run` (def at 582) at its identity comparison.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §11's done-when (plan.html:487-496) names measurable greps and a base delta, asserts whole task-identity keys rather than their first element, and declares two mutations as negative controls (plan.html:498).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §11 changes code and its gate is a pytest delta plus two greps; it names no session-scratch or node-local path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §11 adds no symbol ("No name is added", plan.html:482) and its key literal `("plan-review", …)` carries no plan label, stage name or ticket number.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated predicate disagreement reproduces and the mechanism reaches the production dispatch path. Measured at `fb4b21fb`: a record whose `review` role is set only on its node gives `dispatch_sessions._is_review_run` false and `recovery._is_review_run` true; `round_node_source("plan-review-of-alpha", "review-of-")` is `""` while `round_node_source(..., "plan-review-of-")` is `"alpha"`, so the plan-review key collision the section describes is real. `_task_identity`'s consumers are `_prior_same_task_run` (dispatch_sessions.py:604) and the session decision at `dispatch_sessions.py:688`, both on the dispatch path. The three change bullets (delete the dispatch copy, key plan reviews by slug, remove the re-export) produce the done-when's whole-key outcomes. The one reasoning defect found is the missing §7 gate, reported once under wiring.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §11 is one deliverable: one review predicate and one task-identity key for it.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §11 (plan.html:475) asserts "§7 must not flip the flag before this section lands", but no relationship carries it: §11's `data-links` is empty and §7 (plan.html:425) conditions its flip on §2 and §3 alone.
